messages:
anya: quick heads-up — i'm scheduling a config-only change for the scheduler in the late-night quiet window (23:00 PT). changes: lower tenant rate_cap for burst lanes, tighten request timeout from 6s -> 5s, and shorten quiet_window for background batch queue. Deploy bot will run the config apply.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created by anya: id=cfg-1725550000, mode=config-only, window=23:00-23:15 PT

```
scheduler:
  batching:
    quiet_window_ms: 1200    # was 2000
    max_batch_size: 64
  routing:
    burst_tenant_rate_cap: 0.7  # fraction of baseline
  timeouts:
    request_ms: 5000  # lowered from 6000
```

mike: can we gate this behind a tiny canary? i'd like 5% of traffic to use new settings for first 5 minutes then ramp.

anya: good call — plan updated to staged rollout 5% -> 25% -> full over 10m increments. if latency P95 rises > 10% or error rate > 0.5% we auto-rollback.

jess: note — it's config-only but routing changes might affect bursty tenants. can we pin high-traffic tenants to current route during canary?

anya: yes, adding tenant pin list. pinning command: `/deploy pin-tenant tenant_id=alpha,bravo,charlie config=cfg-1725550000`

rafael: observability checklist:
- make sure trace sampling is at 100% for canary shards
- enable per-route cost & latency alerts
- add temporary dashboard w/ P50/P95/P99, qps, error rate, and kv-cache hit rate

ops-oncall: i'll be on watch 22:45-00:30 PT. will post updates every 5 min once canary starts :eyes:

mike: quick question about rollback path — is rollback a config revert or a staged unpin + revert? which one triggers the deploy bot?

deploy-bot: Rollback action for cfg-1725550000: `rollback-to=cfg-prev-1725539999` (config revert). If auto-rollback triggers, deploy-bot will revert config and unpin tenants automatically. Manual rollback can be invoked with `/deploy rollback cfg-1725550000 reason="latency spike"`

anya: release notes snippet (short):
- Scheduler tuning: reduced quiet window and request timeout to improve tail latency during background batch processing. Lowered burst rate caps to reduce cross-tenant interference. Staged rollout and auto-rollback configured.

jess: add owner tags to the release note (team=serving-runtime, owner=@anya). Also add follow-up play to evaluate tokenization latency impact.

ops-oncall: if we see KV cache hit rate drop > 8% correlate with P95. i'll invoke manual rollback if thresholds breached and no quick mitigation available.

anya: final checklist before 23:00 PT: 
- [x] pins set for high-traffic tenants
- [x] canary percent configured (5% start)
- [x] rollback plan attached to deploy bot
- [x] dashboard live and shared
- [x] ops assigned

mike: :thumbsup: good to go. posting canary notes to #product-release after first 5m if stable.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: cfg-1725550000 will execute at 1725596400 (23:00 PT). Notifications will post on start, ramp, and completion.

anya: thanks team — i'll ping here during rollout.
